edit.description: the `{@link}` arm, resolved in the citing module's own scope
the arm's cases and the live-tree verdict

summary: Resolve a comment's `{@link}` reference from its citing module, and re-home the thirteen that name a symbol their module cannot reach

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: The citation scan answers every `{@link}` in `src/`, `harness/` and `tests/` against the citing module's own scope, and the live tree carries none it cannot answer.
tests: every `{@link}` reference in a `src/`, `harness/` or `tests/` comment resolves from its citing module
notes: 550 such references ride unchecked today; 13 already dangle. Resolution differs from the backticked-identifier arm on purpose: a `{@link}` is TSDoc's own declaration reference, so it resolves where the comment sits, not repo-wide — which is why the existing arm would pass all 13. Same instrument as the rest of the scan (the program's checker). The verdict needs its own vacuity pin: n > 0 references judged.
